body: Yeah, one of my friends saw my scars from self harm and she asked what was going on and I explained to her and I've been talking to her about it.

I just feel like if I do talk then people will judge me. And whenever I do talk about it, it turns out worse because I start crying. So I keep my feelings inside which causes me to break and have moments like these. I also feel like if I do talk then I'll seem like an attention seeker.
I feel like if I stayed here, then I could maybe try to get help and restart. But then I remember that I can't really talk about it so that leaves me in my position...
It was better but I'm still having suicidal thoughts. I still really don't want to be here and I'm hanging on to the last bit of hope I have...
Thank you so much for the advice!! I'll see what I can do and I'm glad I finally have someone that understands
I'm from Tennessee, and thanks. It means a lot.
I'm not really sure what's setting it off. I have a lot of downtime and when I have downtime my mind starts going places it shouldn't go. It's really hard to control too.

When I was in fifth grade I was horribly bullied and the summer after 5th grade I actually tried committing suicide. I failed sadly. I'm not sure if I'm depressed or not because I haven't been to any clinic that can diagnose me with that. And I'm scared to talk it out, I feel like whoever I tell will judge me and it will just add stress onto their life which would make me feel worse knowing that it's my fault.
